The '''Ice Giant Range''' was a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] range<ref name="DOTJ 6">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 1]]</ref> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] that was home to [[Stav Kesh]], the [[Je'daii Temples|Temple]] of Martial Arts for the [[Je'daii Order]].<ref name="DOTJ 1" /> The mountain range was situated on the continent of [[Kato Zakar]]; it lay almost five hundred [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] inland from the northern shore and twenty-seven hundred kilometers north of the continent's [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] heartlands.<ref name="Into the Void" /> The [[Tho Yor]] pyramid [[Starship/Legends|ship]] that brought the first [[Tythan]] pilgrims to the Ice Giants buried itself in the mountain range, and the Je'daii built Stav Kesh on the slopes above the Tho Yor.<ref name="DOTJ 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ice Giant Range was first pictured in the [[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0|preview issue 0]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], and it appeared in the series' [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|first issue]]<ref name="DOTJ 1" /> and tie-in novel ''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]'',<ref name="Into the Void" /> but it was first named in the series' [[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 1|sixth issue]].<ref name="DOTJ 6" />
